pages.text: You unlock the Nether through the main questline (it needs a book). Get the $(l)Alien Material$() quests done first.$(br2)$(l)Prepare:$()$(li)Full bedrock armor (fire immunity) $(l)plus Magic Protection$().
Blazes and ghasts otherwise one-shot you.$(li)Mobility (glider and sling, later a jetpack) and a ranged weapon (shuriken).$(li)A Mob Crusher with a Spectre Coil makes a handy portable defence.

$(l)In the Nether:$()$(li)Opening the portal makes mobs slightly stronger. It's a small bump, not a wall.$(li)Tunnel through walls and avoid open spaces, where blazes snipe you.$(li)Find a $(l)fortress$() and an $(l)Elemental Chamber$(). The chamber holds mithril and a Blitz spawner.
$(li)$(l)Hydras$() live in bone structures in the Nether.
